appearances.snippet: Open to updating these facts if more information lands upon our desk. We also offered to have him on the show to speak about this. What we have confirmed through other people is that Tyler Clancy was in fact on duty as a Provo police officer on September 11th. He was allegedly at Timpanogos Hospital shortly after Charlie (Charlie Kirk) arrived. And then when Erika Kirk was due to land, it was time.
